ItemID: NA; Title: Iowa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its aggressive metal sound fits my interest in heavier albums like Colony and Death Cult Armageddon.
ItemID: NA; Title: Godsmack; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy riffs fit my taste, but other albums here interest me more this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: City of Evil; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its fast, melodic metal sounds appealing given my interest in Advance And Vanquish.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in heavier, riff-focused music right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its accessible heaviness fits part of my listening, but I would prioritize other choices today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mer De Noms; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After 10.000 Days, I am especially interested in its atmospheric sound and Maynard's vocals.
ItemID: NA; Title: Death Magnetic; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The thrash direction appeals to me, but I would explore the closer matches first.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Sickness; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Ten Thousand Fists makes me want to explore more of Disturbed's aggressive sound.
ItemID: NA; Title: Believe; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this for more of the melodic, heavy Disturbed sound I have recently explored.
ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its raw, repetitive approach is less appealing right now than melodic metal or atmospheric rock.
